workflow: Use the current run roles and actual RUN ROLE BINDINGS. Missing or inconsistent identity is a gap; do not guess or take over older panes.

Verify each referenced goal, plan and completed receipt against its saved SHA256 before use. Missing or changed references are a gap: do not dispatch against them or silently accept a new hash. The wrapper freezes the message body, not referenced files.

Check the frozen goal, authorized scope and Research plan. Create a Worker body-file containing the exact method version, frozen acceptance or approved file paths with SHA256, project rules, approved inputs, allowed writes, rollback, deliverables and receipt contract.
Dispatch Worker with wrapper send, a fresh message ID and that body-file. Wait for the role's real terminal receipt and artifacts; submission success is insufficient.
Create a QA body-file with the frozen acceptance, exact artifact version, approved evidence and no hidden answers or private memory. Dispatch QA independently with wrapper send.
For a defect, preserve QA evidence, route a bounded Worker repair and a separate QA retest. Do not edit either role's findings.
Send a Research feedback body-file containing real Worker/QA evidence, failures, costs and unknowns. Research may revise method within the frozen contract.

After an actual cycle, send Curator only an approved evidence pack for a project method candidate. Check sources and independent validation before any limited trial; bind its version, finite task IDs, deadline and stop conditions before use; preserve counterexamples and rollback.
Write an evidence-based summary. Complete your own receipt only when the assigned cycle has a real outcome; report failed or pending work truthfully.

lifecycle.temporary_role_cleanup: only after actual terminal receipts, no observed pending tools or approvals, final capture and explicit current run authorization
